transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… work, mostly. I guess I scared people there.

I’ve been kind of… freezing in the middle of service, or doing things wrong. Like I was standing by the soda station holding the cash drawer key and just repeating table numbers instead of closing out checks. My manager thought I should come in.
Have you been feeling anxious or nervous at work when these episodes happen?
I don’t know… not exactly nervous. I mean, work is stressful, but when it happens I’m more just… stuck, I guess. Hard to explain.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear or discomfort at work or anywhere else?
I don’t think so. Not like… sudden terror or anything. I get uncomfortable sometimes, but I wouldn’t call it intense fear.
Do you feel like you're outside of your body or watching yourself when you get stuck like that?
Not really… I don’t think so. It’s more like I just can’t get myself to move or think right for a minute. Not like I’m watching myself from somewhere else.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?
Um… I don’t know. Not really, I guess. I mean, I think about stuff, but I don’t know if it’s like… stuck in my head that way.
Do you find yourself avoiding certain tasks or situations at work because of these episodes?

Yeah… a little. I try not to be the one closing checks sometimes, or I hang back from the soda station when it’s busy. I’ve frozen up there before, just standing with the cash drawer key and… saying table numbers to myself instead of doing what I was supposed to do. It scared people, I think.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
I don’t think so. Not like a thought looping over and over… at least I haven’t really noticed that.
Have you ever had an episode where you felt an overwhelming sense of fear or discomfort that came on very suddenly?
I’m not sure… I don’t think so. I mean, I get uncomfortable sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it comes on all at once like that.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel compelled to think about over and over?
Not really… I don’t feel like I have to think something again and again. I mean, my mind gets stuck sometimes, but not like that, I don’t think.
Have you ever had an episode where you felt a sudden, intense fear or discomfort that seemed to come out of nowhere?
No… I don’t think so. I get uneasy sometimes, but not like sudden intense fear out of nowhere.
Do you ever feel like you're detached from yourself or your surroundings when you're not having one of these freezing episodes?
I don’t really know… I haven’t noticed feeling detached like that. Maybe I get kind of spaced out sometimes, but not really separate from myself or anything.
Have you ever had a panic attack?
I don’t think so… not like a panic attack, no.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel are intrusive or unwelcome?
I’m not sure… I mean, I get thoughts I don’t like sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d call them intrusive. Nothing I can really explain.
Do you have any thoughts that you try to ignore or suppress?
I don’t really know… I guess I try not to think about some things, but I wouldn’t say there’s a specific thought I’m fighting off all the time.
Do you have any thoughts that keep coming back to you even when you try to think about something else?
I don’t think so… not in a way I’ve really noticed. Sometimes my mind goes back to things, but I don’t know if it’s like that.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel are recurring and unwanted?
Not really… I don’t think I have anything that keeps coming back like that. I mean, I have thoughts I don’t want sometimes, but not… recurring, I guess.
Do you ever feel like the world around you is unreal or distant?
I’m not sure… I don’t think so. Sometimes I feel kind of spaced out, but I wouldn’t say the world feels unreal exactly.
Do you ever feel like you're observing yourself from outside your body?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I can feel kind of off sometimes, but not like I’m outside myself watching.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or disconnected from what's happening around you?
Maybe sometimes I feel a little out of it, but… I don’t know if I’d call it disconnected. I haven’t really noticed it like that.
Do you ever feel like you're observing yourself from outside your body or like you're in a dream?
Not really… I don’t think I feel like I’m outside my body or in a dream. Just kind of tired or foggy sometimes, maybe.
